name: comp-211
blurb: Required select field with visual indicator.
description: A shadcn Select marked as required with a red asterisk in the label to signal mandatory input.
use_when: A selection is required for form submission or data validation.
avoid_when: When the field is truly optional or when you want to indicate optionality instead.
a11y: Required attribute set; label includes visual asterisk but no aria-required attribute.
